notes.title: Gamepad support in progress 🎮✨
notes.notes: [p]Hello friends![/p][p]It’s been a while since my last update, and the most important thing to say is that \[b]Fix This House\[/b] is not abandoned. During the summer, I took a little break from development to rest and reset my mind. That pause gave me fresh energy to continue working on the game.[/p][p]Right now, I’m focusing on adding full \[b]gamepad support\[/b]. Basic controls — movement, zoom and work with blocks — are already working! I’m currently finishing the button remapping system so you can fully customize the controls to your liking.[/p][p]I’m also working on supporting the most popular controllers: \[b]X-Box\[/b], \[b]PlayStation\[/b], \[b]Steam Controller\[/b], \[b]Steam Deck\[/b], and more. Each device has its own quirks, and I want to make sure everything feels smooth and natural.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45037827/1f86810a64181e5e87eddd83af06a95c96530f29.png"][/img][/p][p]A lot of work has been done already, but there’s still plenty ahead. Thank you for staying with me and waiting patiently for updates! ❤️[/p][p]More news is coming soon![/p]

notes.title: Updated Levels, Improved Placement Area, and others!
notes.notes:
Hello! 🖖

I’m happy to share a fresh [b]Fix This House[/b] update! This one makes the game more intuitive and enjoyable, especially for new players.

✨ [b]Animated Placement Area[/b] – the block placement zone now gently bounces and levitates above the surface, making the building process feel even smoother!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45037827/9d91f672bac5ecec90db9e5036529424d48cd27a.gif[/img]

🏡 [b]New and Reworked Levels[/b] – I’ve added levels 2, 3, and updated level 5 to introduce mechanics more gradually. Now, the journey into Fix This House feels even more natural.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45037827/6a0f55bc47f461abfd6e79aa257470ba20974f70.png[/img]

🎥 [b]New Setting[/b] – you can now disable the [b]Camera Lens[/b] effect in the settings if you prefer.

🖱 [b]More Comfortable Controls[/b] – camera movement is now mapped to the left mouse button by default (previously, it was the middle mouse button). If you liked the old setting, you can always change it back!

📌 [b]What’s next?[/b] I’m starting work on the main levels! It’ll take some time, but I’ll try to share updates along the way. Thanks for playing! 😊

notes.title: New Visuals, Improved UI, and a Better First Level!
notes.notes:
Hello! 🖖

It’s been quite some time since the last Fix This House update – sorry about that! I had some things to take care of in real life, but now everything’s fine, and I can continue working on the game. And here is a new update 🎉

📸 Tilt Shift Effect – I’ve reworked the blur effect to create a soft tilt-shift look, making objects feel a bit more toy-like when viewed up close. The focus now adjusts automatically to whatever is in the center of the screen.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45037827/8edb1230760c004ed696278ed9c61bc0d1297b8a.gif[/img]

🎮 Updated Control Hints – I’ve redesigned the icons to better represent their actions. Hopefully, they’ll be easier to notice (and don't miss it)!

🏡 A New First Level – The building area has been moved to the center, making it easier to get started and more comfortable to play.

🚧 What’s next? A new update is coming soon with more early levels that better explain the mechanics and make the learning process more intuitive. Thanks for playing – there’s much more to come! 😊

Cheers,
Mikhail

notes.title: New Control Customization!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 👋

I’m excited to share a new update for [b]Fix This House[/b] that brings even more flexibility to the way you play. You can now fully customize the controls for camera movement, zoom, and block rotation. 🎮

These new options let you set up the game exactly how you like it, making the experience smoother and more comfortable. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45037827/15dd70a34f6672e980b40468740008783ac817f9.png[/img]

I’ve designed these changes to be as intuitive and responsive as possible, and I hope they make your building adventures even more relaxing and enjoyable!

As always, I’d love to hear your feedback. Enjoy customizing your controls and making the game feel just right! 😊

Cheers,
Mikhail

notes.title: New Hints and UI improvements – Demo Update Now Live!
notes.notes:
Hello 🖖

I’m excited to share a new update for [b]Fix This House Demo[/b] that I’ve been working on. The past few weeks have been all about making the game even more relaxing and enjoyable, and I think you’ll love the new additions!

One of the biggest changes is the hint system. Now, if you need a little guidance, you can see a subtle silhouette of the final building, helping you visualize the finished structure. It's there to gently guide you without taking away from the fun of figuring things out.

I’ve also added a block counter, so you can easily keep track of how many blocks you’ve placed and how many are left. It’s a small addition, but it helps bring a nice sense of progress and clarity as you play.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45037827/0fccf5cd76a2df6aafbaf53f1cef15a8f7a6bf3b.png[/img]
Lastly, I’ve squashed a few small visual bugs to make everything run more smoothly, so the experience should feel cleaner and more polished now.

I hope these changes make [b]Fix This House Demo[/b] even cozier and more satisfying to play! Can’t wait to hear what you think.

[i]See you at steam fest, 
Mikhail[/i] 😉

notes.title: Pastel Perfection
notes.notes:
Hello!

I’ve spent the last few weeks carefully refining a brand new color palette for every level. Each palette has been meticulously crafted to embrace soft, pastel tones, giving the game a fresh and inviting feel. The colors now seamlessly blend with the overall design, creating a warm and harmonious atmosphere in every corner of the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45037827/e9a6ecf904101e64114ab46f426d87afafdf1f80.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45037827/600be5e68d9460306c950c0242eefeec263bee0c.png[/img]

In addition to that, I’ve added some lovely new animations to the levels, bringing a touch of life and movement to your building experience. You’ll notice little details that make the world feel even more dynamic and interactive.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45037827/bb5091a8fb5b8cf53790e5b70a9f011708ea36fe.gif[/img]

Lastly, I’ve also fixed an old issue with the blocks that were hiding beneath the surface. Now, everything works as it should, making your playthroughs much smoother and more enjoyable 🛠️

I hope these changes bring extra charm to the game, and I can’t wait to hear your thoughts!

Cheers,
Mikhail 😉

notes.title: Wettest update!
notes.notes:
Hello!
I’m thrilled to announce some exciting updates I’ve been working on for [b]Fix This House[/b]! The graphics have received a nice polish, with a new LEGO-like effect to bring a bit more charm to your building experience. I’ve also reworked several levels and added some fun, interactive elements.

You’ll now find [b]flowers[/b] on lamp posts, adding a soft, decorative touch. There’s even a bell sound when the small boat on the water is triggered—here’s a little sneak peek of it in action 🌼
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45037827/aa1b18abb2b080f6a86833d8ec75247667bceef3.gif[/img]

For the winter map, I’ve added a [b]snowman[/b]! It brings a playful feel to the cold, snowy levels, and I hope you’ll enjoy it as much as I did creating it ☃️
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45037827/2e36d966d55996b92d8c26310aa6958274c4b839.gif[/img]

I’ve also placed [b]hydrants[/b] in the city locations. They can be activated by hitting them or simply clicking on them for a fun surprise! Check out the water burst in this clip 💦
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45037827/9c67b582046025000d7a5521af18bfa7438cafaf.gif[/img]

I hope these little touches bring a bit of extra charm and life into the game, and I can’t wait to hear what you think!

Cheers, Mikhail 😉

notes.title: Fix This House!
notes.notes:
I'm excited to share a fresh update for [b]Fix This House[/b] (previously known as [b]Please Fix The Building[/b]). This update brings a beautiful new background that adds a touch of mystery to your building adventures. I've also given the graphics a slight polish, making the game world even more charming ✨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45037827/a68318c7ef2c43a508808acb8e1428775940c65d.gif[/img]

One of the most requested features is now live—you can skip the intro and level transition animations! ⏩ I’ve also reworked the level transition animation to make it faster, so you can get back to building in no time.

I also want to address the recent name change. Some players found the original title, [b]Please Fix The Building[/b], confusing, thinking it was a sequel to [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1383250/Please_Fix_The_Road/]Please Fix The Road[/url][/b]. I apologize for any confusion this caused. I genuinely thought [b]Please Fix The Building[/b] was a fitting name, one that could have been part of a fun bundle with [b]Please Fix The Road[/b]. However, to avoid any further mix-ups, the game will now be known as [b]Fix This House[/b]. I hope you enjoy the updates, and as always, thank you for your support! ❤️

notes.title: Demo update 1.0.4 is out!
notes.notes:
Hello, builders! I've been hard at work to bring you some fantastic improvements and new features for [b]Please Fix The Building[/b]. Here’s what’s new:

🎧 [b]Audio Fixes:[/b] I've resolved the inverted audio issue. Now, the sounds of construction are crisp and immersive!

❄️ [b]Reworked 5th Level:[/b] Step into a snowy paradise! The 5th level has been transformed into a winter scene, with gentle snow gradually covering all the blocks.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45037827/4726dfa8bcef364b5f038312220850f68373de11.gif[/img]

🔊 [b]Balanced Impact Sounds:[/b] I've normalized the loudness of impact sounds, ensuring a balanced and pleasant auditory experience.

🎆 [b]Celebratory Fireworks:[/b] Finish a level and be rewarded with a delightful fireworks animation. Your achievements deserve a celebration!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45037827/907850a8e7d897722c0386525fd03cee2a77f96b.gif[/img]

I hope you enjoy these updates and enhancements. As always, your feedback is invaluable to me. Dive in, build to your heart's content, and let me know what you think!

Happy building! 🏗️

notes.title: Please Fix The Building Demo is out now 🏘️
notes.notes:
Please Fix The Building Demo has been released and is now available for everyone to try! 🎉

[b]Controls[/b]
Use your mouse to play.
* Hold the left button to drag the cubes.
* Hold the right button to rotate the camera.
* Hold the middle button to move the camera.
* Use the wheel to zoom or to rotate the cube while holding it.

[b]Gameplay[/b]
Place the cubes so that the window, balcony or roof do not rest against the wall. In the game, click on the house button to get hints on what is missing for the house.

[b]Is there a tutorial?[/b]
Not yet, but I will add it as soon as possible.

[b]Does it support a controller?[/b]
Unfortunatelly, not yet. But I will add it too!

[b]Does it run on Linux?[/b]
* Yes! This is my first time making a build for Linux. Please, if something doesn't work for you - let me know!

[b]Feedback 📝[/b]
* You are also welcome to share your thoughts and suggestions under this post or via discussion, discord, email or anything else. You can find me on Discord server, please [url=https://discord.gg/P66AKVbaTD]click here to join it[/url].

[b]Streaming 📷[/b]
* Quick tip: if you're streaming or making a video, you don't have to mute the music 🎶

I hope you have a good time with the demo which will bring relaxation!
